description: Fig. 5 - Maximum supported output length per backend (log2 scale). Values are max output tokens before OOM; strings mark the first failing cause: WEIGHT_OOM = weight-load OOM (W), FAIL_INIT = backend initialization failure (I), KV_OOM = KV-allocation OOM (KV), FOOTPRINT = model footprint exceeding combined CPU+GPU memory (F). Cells the paper reports only graphically (bar heights without an explicit number in the text or caption) are marked NOT_REPORTED here; the authoritative values are the bars in Fig. 5 of the paper and the raw outputs of the experiments/paper_bench.py max-decode probe (section F of run_paper_experiments.sh).

headline_ratios.note: Ratio = HELM max output tokens / strongest feasible baseline. Geometric mean over the feasible Qwen3 model x GPU pairs (a pair is feasible when at least one baseline produces output; Qwen3-32B on RTX 3090 has no baseline long-output point and is excluded) is 5.9x; the maximum is 256x (Qwen3-14B on RTX 3090: HELM 32K vs. Accelerate 128).

produced_by: experiments/paper_bench.py max_decode_length probe, i.e. section F of experiments/run_paper_experiments.sh (run with SECTIONS=F; off by default)
